entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Diwan Mosque is a mosque in Fez, Morocco. It was founded by the Alawi sultan Moulay Slimane during his reign between 1792 and 1822. It is located in the center of Fes el-Bali, on Diwan Street, just north of Tala'a Kebira near its eastern end. It is one of the neighbourhood Friday mosques of the city.
